criterion_dictionary.COMP1: Covers all explicit requirements from source input
criterion_dictionary.COMP2: Addresses edge cases and failure scenarios
criterion_dictionary.COMP5: Specifies what is explicitly out of scope
criterion_dictionary.COR1: No factual errors or hallucinated claims
criterion_dictionary.COR2: Technical approaches are feasible with stated constraints
criterion_dictionary.COR3: Terminology used consistently and accurately throughout
criterion_dictionary.COR4: No internal contradictions (cross-validated with quantitative IC metric)
criterion_dictionary.COR5: Claims supported by evidence or rationale within the document
criterion_dictionary.STR3: Clear separation of concerns between sections
criterion_dictionary.STR4: Navigation aids present (table of contents, cross-references, or index)
criterion_dictionary.STR5: Follows conventions of the artifact type
criterion_dictionary.CLR2: Concrete rather than abstract (specific actions, not general principles)
criterion_dictionary.CLR3: Each section has a clear purpose statement or can be summarized in one sentence
criterion_dictionary.CLR4: Acronyms and domain terms defined on first use
criterion_dictionary.CLR5: Actionable next steps or decision points clearly identified
criterion_dictionary.RISK1: Identifies at least 3 risks with probability and impact assessment
criterion_dictionary.RISK2: Provides mitigation strategy for each identified risk
criterion_dictionary.RISK3: Addresses failure modes and recovery procedures
criterion_dictionary.RISK4: Considers external dependencies and their failure scenarios
criterion_dictionary.RISK5: Includes monitoring or validation mechanism for risk detection
criterion_dictionary.EDGE1: Addresses boundary conditions for collections (empty, single-element, maximum size)
criterion_dictionary.EDGE2: Handles state variable interactions across component boundaries
criterion_dictionary.EDGE3: Identifies guard condition gaps (missing validation, unguarded type assumptions)
criterion_dictionary.EDGE4: Covers count divergence scenarios (off-by-one, inclusive/exclusive ranges)
criterion_dictionary.EDGE5: Considers interaction effects when features or components combine
